dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Most definitely. In fact, there is a question I wanted to ask you.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Well... Sometimes, when we receive visitors at the workshop, I am required to act as host.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: They are of various ages and have different personalities and occupations. I cannot always determine the most suitable topic of conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: You have traveled far and wide, and made many friends along the way. What do you talk about when meeting someone for the first time?

choices.text: Just... the usual stuff that people talk about.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I see... Then, perhaps I can build a list of general-purpose conversation topics — such as local delicacies, recent weather patterns, major news items...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: By periodically updating the list, I can ensure it is fit for use with any visitor.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: This seems to be a dependable socializing strategy, and the cost-benefit ratio is rather impressive.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: It is an excellent suggestion. I knew you were the right person to ask.

choices.text: You're a fast learner. But no surprises there!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I have come to understand that the transition from "casual conversation partner" to "friend" requires an extended period of data transfer between the two parties.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I believe the process of bridging this knowledge gap is typically referred to as "getting to know one another," correct?

choices.text: That's right. It takes time to truly know another human being.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Indeed. When I meet someone that I wish to understand more deeply, I will ask them the following: "Can you tell me more about yourself? I am very curious."

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: After gathering sufficient data, I can perform a more accurate assessment of the other party's personality and preferred modes of interaction. Then, I can adjust my conversation strategy accordingly.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: The process of getting to know another person is also a process of getting to know myself. As well as building rapport and friendship, I also hope to become a better version of myself along the way.

choices.text: Surface-level interactions aren't enough to build genuine understanding.
I'm sure you'll make lots of friends too.
I try to guess what the other person is into.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I see... So, perhaps I should start building conversation banks based around different occupations?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: For instance, the "adventurer" conversation bank might include well-paid commissions, rumors about secret treasure, intel on monsters...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: While the "merchant" conversation bank might include the latest market headlines, recent consumer trends, store rental prices...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: This approach requires substantial data-gathering up front, but the ability to converse with any visitor in their own domain of expertise would likely boost my socializing efforts greatly.
